description: A phase modulation effect for any two audio signals: the carrier is written into a delay line and the modulator moves the point it is read back from, which gives the harmonics of DX-style FM

params.text: Sets how far the modulator moves the read point, reaching 50 samples per volt of modulator at full travel; more of it adds higher harmonics
Attenuates and inverts the DEPTH CV input, from -1 at full counter-clockwise through 0 at noon to +1 at full clockwise, before it is added to the FM DEPTH knob

inputs.text: The carrier, which is the signal written into the delay line and read back modulated
The modulator, whose voltage moves the read point and so modulates the phase of the carrier
Modulates the FM depth: the voltage is divided by 5, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the FM DEPTH knob, and the total is clamped to the knob's own 0 to 1 range

outputs.text: The modulated carrier, at as many channels as the wider of IN and MOD IN

notes: the read point starts 5ms behind the write point, so the output lags the input by 5ms with no modulation applied
depth changes are smoothed, each sample moving a thousandth of the way to the new value, so turning FM DEPTH or moving its CV arrives over a few tens of milliseconds

inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
